[[Ambassador Zain]] is struggling to protect his supply lines from local bandits. As a [[Kryta]]n diplomat in a highly suspicious [[Ascalon]], he cannot risk a political incident by shedding Ascalonian blood himself. Help him get rid of this threat.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites

}}

===Objectives===
* Go to [[Regent Valley]]. Hunt down the bandit [[Torin]].
* Return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.

==Walkthrough==
The easiest way to complete this quest is to wait until you get to [[Fort Ranik (outpost)|Fort Ranik]] (after finishing the [[The Great Northern Wall]]).

Head south from Fort Ranik. A group of [[Charr]] may come running from the arches to ambush you, so take them out. Head west, following the arches. Along the way, you'll engage scattered groups of [[Renegade]]s and [[Renegade Elementalist]]s. Turn north at the next fork, watching your step for burrowing [[Devourer]]s, which may pop up from the ground. Cross the bridge and take out the first group of Renegades after the bridge. Then, head west to a dead end where Torin and two Renegade Elementalists are standing. Eliminate the bandit leader and return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ambassador Zain
:''"Alas, despite the current peace between Kryta and Ascalon, your [[King Adelbern]] still chooses to view all Krytans with distrust. He respects the old laws too much to do anything untoward, but I must take care not to give him excuse to expel me from the kingdom. Therein lies my trouble.''

:''"Unable to enter the city, my men have been forced to travel south to '''Regent Valley''' to re-supply and have been victimized repeatedly by a bandit named '''Torin'''. We would hunt down Torin ourselves, but shedding the blood of an Ascalon, even a criminal like Torin, might be a mistake. Will you attend to this bandit threat for me?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = I'm sorry. I have other things I must do.
| ask = I am relying on you to deal with this '''Torin''' for me. Each day his exploits go without consequence, others are emboldened to victimize us.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Ambassador Zain
:''"You have my sincerest thanks for ridding us of that troublesome Torin. It gives me hope to see that not all the people of Ascalon are blinded by the troubles of old. May the [[Unseen Ones]] watch over you."''
